hook: Clumps of ESCRT-0 protein bud vesicles off cilia without the usual ESCRT-III machinery.
summary: Cilia release small vesicles that carry the Hedgehog receptor SMO, and this work shows that ESCRT-0 condenses at the ciliary tip and clusters ubiquitinated SMO to make them bud. Blocking condensation stopped SMO release, and forcing ESCRT-0 together with light-controlled SMO clustering rebuilt budding. The experiments were done in mouse kidney cells, so other cell types are untested.
title: ESCRT-0 condensation and cargo clustering drive extracellular vesicle budding from cilia.
